lines: [icy, smiling] Well, that's the problem with thinking, isn't it?
[rising, furious] You heard me. Get out of my house.
[calm, cold] Then I hope you have the paperwork.
[not meeting her eyes] Maybe you should go home for tonight.
[desperate] I was going to pay it back!
[laughing] Nobody's yelling. That's a pretty good start.
[measured] The house Victoria lives in is owned by the Ashford Family Trust.
[warm, teasing] What? I'm old. I'm allowed to tell the truth.
